text:
Maya Patel: quick preflight — want to run the marketplace listing + ingest smoke for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant before we lock the joint announcement next week. who can own the end-to-end run?

Ajay Singh: I can drive the smoke pipeline tomorrow morning. timeline?

Maya Patel: thanks. goal is: validate connector packaging, sample ingest latency, and listing metadata (logos, SKU, pricing tier) so GTM has a clean artifact. ideally done by EOD Thu.

Lina Gomez: I'll handle the marketplace metadata and the PR for logos. need final logo svg + short description from partner. @Jules can you confirm partner assets?

Jules Park: asked partner PM for assets, they said 48h. can we do a partial listing (placeholder logo) and iterate?

Maya Patel: placeholder ok but must be flagged as DRAFT in marketplace UI. legal ok with that @Bobby?

Bobby Chen: draft placeholder ok, but no public announcement. add clause in listing metadata: "preview build, not GA". I'll post the exact copy in #legal later.

Ajay Singh: infra run notes: using smoke harness in staging cluster -> connectors: snowbridge (Snowflake), dbx-ingest (Databricks), qdrant-sidecar (vector). target sample size: 1000 docs, 512 tokens avg.

Ajay Singh: small script i will run:
```bash
# smoke ingest
python infra/tools/smoke_ingest.py \
  --connector snowbridge --dest-table test_marketplace_ingest \
  --parallel 8 --count 1000 \
  --vector-backend qdrant://staging-qdrant:6333
```

Ajay Singh: expected failure modes to watch: auth/sts cross-account, parquet schema mismatch, vector dimensionality mismatch. log to /var/log/marketplace-smoke.log

Lina Gomez: also need to validate marketplace manifest fields:
```yaml
name: "Partner X Connector (Snow/DBX)"
sku: "partnerx-snow-dbx-vector"
category: "Data Connectors"
visibility: "private-preview"
pricing: "metered-requests"
```

Maya Patel: good. Ajay, can you add a fail-fast check that stops pipeline if >5% rows fail schema validation? we don't want noisy metrics.

Ajay Singh: will add validator. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/connectors/pull/312 (adds smoke harness + validator).

infra-bot: deploy-staging: connector-smoke-run started by Ajay Singh at 2026-04-02T09:05:12Z

Ajay Singh: ran first pass, got 87% success, failures are 13% mostly schema/parquet issues from partner sample. attaching minimal repro log: /tmp/smoke_fail_sample.log

Lina Gomez: 13% is high. partner sample dataset might be using nested JSON types we don't support. @Jules escalate to partner data team?

Jules Park: yes, I'll escalate now. quick ask: can partner normalize to flattened schema? that removes most failures.

Bobby Chen: while we wait, legal needs to confirm data retention settings for staging ingest. set retention to 7 days and purge logs after 14 days.

Maya Patel: agree. set config flag: "retention_days: 7" in manifest. Lina, update manifest before listing.

Lina Gomez: updated manifest and committed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-manifests/commit/4f2a1b

Ajay Singh: re-run smoke with schema validator turned on. command:
```bash
python infra/tools/smoke_ingest.py --connector snowbridge --count 1000 --validator-on --parallel 8
```

infra-bot: deploy-staging: connector-smoke-run completed (success_rate=97%)

Ajay Singh: success rate 97% now. remaining failures are 1) a timestamp parsing edgecase and 2) vector dim mismatch -> partner sent 128-d vectors, our qdrant instance expects 256.

Maya Patel: we need to document the vector-dim requirement in the listing and in onboarding docs. Lina, add to README and marketplace manifest notes.

Lina Gomez: done. README PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/connector-docs/pull/89 - adds vector dim and supported Snowflake types.

Jules Park: partner agreed to re-export vectors at 256 dims. they'll send new sample by EOD.

Bobby Chen: OK to move to private-preview listing in marketplace after we confirm partner assets and retention policy. legal approves the draft language I posted in #legal.

Maya Patel: go/no-go checklist for announcement:
- assets (logo, description) [Lina/Jules]
- smoke pass >=95% [Ajay]
- manifest + README updated [Lina]
- legal copy + retention set [Bobby]
- GTM announcement one-pager (internal) [Maya]

Maya Patel: plan: if all green by Fri 17:00 PT, schedule a soft-launch to selected accounts next Tue.

Ajay Singh: will add a post-run smoke artifact: perf report + token-cost estimate and link it in this thread.

Lina Gomez: small note for listing: set "support_contact": "partner@partnerx.com" and add "integration_level": "managed".

infra-bot: artifact-upload: s3://redwood-staging/marketplace/smoke_runs/3860012345/report.json

Maya Patel: thanks everyone. action items assigned in Asana: https://app.asana.com/0/0/1201234567890 - please update by EOD.

Jules Park: partner assets incoming. will confirm when uploaded.

Bobby Chen: thumbs up from legal on draft. add the clause: "preview build — do not externalize" to metadata.

Maya Patel: excellent. we will reconvene Fri 09:00 PT for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
